_about: Service NPCs (bankers, auctioneers, flight masters) that WoW Forever adds, or moves from where vanilla had them.
The vanilla positions come from the CMaNGOS classic-db spawn table; this file is for what that table cannot know.
Positions are the game's own map coordinates: percent across (x) and down (y) the zone map named by uiMap.
Stand at the NPC in game, target it, and run the macro in the README ('Adding an NPC') — it prints a ready-made line.
roles: any of banker, auctioneer, flightmaster. react: [Alliance, Horde] with 1 friendly, 0 neutral, -1 hostile.
An entry whose name matches a vanilla NPC replaces that NPC's position; anything else is added.
